name: Terrain gallery (p303, p304, p305)
description: The toolkit's terrain texture library, one isolated 12 × 12 m block per texture set (rows from the back: sand and mud, rocks and cliffs, snow and ice, grass and concrete), each drawn by the toolkit's terrain material (p305, its JSON route; one layer, world tiling) in the set's default packing, which the debug tab switches to the code route or to the baseline textureSetSurface (they look the same). Each block is a generated terrain with gentle 0.4 m noise and its back edge raised into a 35° ramp; the cliff blocks have a 6 m wall (tiled at its UVs in metres). Right of the library, the Procedural row (p304): the toolkit's ten surface generators on a block each (five rows of two), baked at the load (1024² LITE), which the debug tab switches between the bake, the generator live in the material and an imported set of its category, with each generator's params, its export and a GPU measurement. The DAY_NIGHT sky stands still at 10:00 and lights the scene.
